renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D subtractive closure relief
primitiveBudget: one generated relief tablet, eleven interlocking ribs, three fixed lift sites, one real negative cutout per accepted lift, and four liftable subtractions
commitThreshold: press one fixed edge, travel inward at least 0.62 normalized units, reverse toward that edge, then release
memoryRule: the hand path disappears; the selected edge stays exact while a real cutout removes material and neighbouring ribs close around it; four subtractions persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch starts at one of three upper lift sites, moves inward, returns, and releases; ArrowLeft/ArrowUp/ArrowRight selects, Enter/Space performs the same deterministic lift; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: full-field wash, pigment islands, and folded sheet -> one compact relief tablet made from interlocking ribs and negative cuts
compositionRupture: wash corridor, loose ecology, and upright sheet -> dense asymmetrical relief with a single material mass and three upper lift edges
encounterRupture: proximity, ordered passage, and simultaneous chord -> reversible inward-and-return lift from one fixed edge
temporalRupture: remote delayed answer and internal fold -> committed subtraction whose absence remains where the gesture is no longer present
mediumRupture: wash, island silhouettes, and fold planes -> generated Canvas 2D relief ribs, void cutouts, closure edges, and material shadows
changedRule: Pressure cannot add a mark. Only a reversible lift removes a real cutout, and neighbouring ribs change their geometry to close around the missing edge.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one warm, dark relief of eleven interlocking ribs. Each accepted return leaves a deep irregular opening and shifts adjacent ribs; four absences compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if a short or one-way stroke commits, if the lifted edge deforms, if the cutout is only colour or readout, if later removals reset earlier ones, if lifting is inexact, or if the blind relief reads as another sheet, field, route, or generic cutout poster.
deletionCondition: Delete v050 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish subtractive material memory from v047-v049's displaced response grammar, or if reversal is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
